# Example user guides

[Example documentation](../README.md)

Step-by-step guides with screenshots, one per user journey. They are regenerated by the end-to-end tests, so they always match the application.

**Table 1 — User journeys**

| Journey | Who | Goal |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Explore the examples](explore-the-examples.md) | A developer evaluating the OoBDev framework | See which framework features have a working example and confirm the API behind them is healthy. |
| [Chat with a local model](chat-with-a-local-model.md) | A developer trying the AI abstractions without a cloud account | Ask a question and read the answer from a model that runs in the Ollama container. |
| [Hold a conversation with Ollama](hold-a-conversation.md) | A developer checking that the model remembers earlier turns | Ask two questions in a row and see the conversation context carried between them. |
| [Compare two texts with embeddings](compare-two-texts.md) | A developer learning how semantic similarity works | Turn two sentences into vectors and read how close they are. |
| [Ask a question about your own text](ask-your-own-documents.md) | A developer learning retrieval augmented generation | Give the model a few passages, ask a question, and see which passages the answer came from. |
| [Check the running service](check-the-running-service.md) | An operator | See which environment the API runs in and find a configuration setting. |
| [Cache a value](cache-a-value.md) | A developer adding caching to a service | Store text under a key, read it back, and remove it. |
| [Hash, sign, compare and calculate](use-the-toolbox.md) | A developer checking integrity and similarity | Hash some text, sign a message with a shared secret, measure how far apart two vectors are, evaluate an expression and get a one-time code. |
| [Query a document and render Markdown](query-and-render-text.md) | A developer pulling values out of mixed documents | Query a JSON document with XPath, see the XML view XPath works on, and render Markdown. |
| [Store texts and find the closest](store-and-search-vectors.md) | A developer adding semantic search to an application | Embed a few sentences into a collection and find the ones closest in meaning to a query. |
| [Compare a set of vectors](compare-vectors.md) | A data scientist checking how close embeddings are | Measure every pair in a small set of vectors and see their lengths and centroid. |
| [Label an image without training](label-an-image.md) | A developer adding image understanding | Rank free-text labels against a picture and see its embedding. |
| [Render a text template](render-a-template.md) | A developer producing documents or email bodies from data | Fill a template with JSON data and read the result. |
| [Send an email through a channel](send-an-email.md) | A developer wiring notifications into an application | Send a message through the public channel and read the acknowledgement. |
| [Put a message on a queue](queue-a-message.md) | A developer testing asynchronous processing | Enqueue a message and find the event reference that describes the queue. |
| [Convert and store a document](convert-a-document.md) | A developer handling uploaded files | Upload a file, convert it to plain text and keep it in the document store. |
| [Sign in with Keycloak](sign-in.md) | A user opening the example for the first time | Sign in through the identity provider and land on the screen that was asked for. |
| [See the claims on your token](see-who-you-are.md) | A developer checking authentication | Read the claims the API sees for the current user. |
